bullets.text: A history-sheeter was hacked to death in Adyar, Chennai, leading to three arrests and allegations against police by the mother.
Severe cyclone impacts in Thiruvallur and Chennai caused high sea waves and water inundation in Bharathiyar Nagar, requiring public warnings.
Five workers suffered food poisoning from contaminated rice at a Gummidipoondi factory canteen in Thiruvallur district.
Passengers fear Chennai airport shutdowns due to delayed stormwater drain work during heavy rains.
MLA Sowmiya Anbumani urged the Tamil Nadu government to issue an official notification recognizing the Pallikaranai marshland.
Following complaints, the highways department closed potholes on the Tambaram-Velachery road using resin binder.
Police seized a lorry and arrested a driver for smuggling sand through the Tiruttani Ponpadi checkpost from Andhra Pradesh.
School students participated in a special weapons and antique gun exhibition hosted by the Tamil Nadu Special Police in Avadi.
Tata Communications plans to invest up to $450 million for a 10,000-kilometer AI-ready connectivity network across India.
OneQode secured 14 MW of Chennai AI capacity through an agreement with AdaniConneX.
Sarvam AI signed a five-year agreement with the Ministry of Defence to develop sovereign artificial intelligence applications for the military.
Protests and black flag demonstrations occurred in Tiruvallur following government notices regarding government land occupation under CM Vijay.
MP Kanimozhi criticized the administration for failing to control the prices of Aavin products.
